findings.claim: Evidence lines said a ticket's plan and verdicts are in `.loop/archive/` before `5b2ed1b`, false for 14 tickets.
minio.md said R10 to R12 were all stubs at the reset.

The new Evidence wording calls `48f52e2` "the last commit before the `5b2ed1b` loop reset", but the parent of `5b2ed1b` is `2259e07`, with three stamp-only commits between them. The files the lines point to are the same at both commits, so readers still find them.

verdict.text: Both findings sent back are fixed.
No line in the bundle still makes a false `.loop/archive/` claim, and each of the 49 tickets the new Evidence lines name has files under `.loop/` at `48f52e2`.
minio.md now says R10 and R11 were stubs and R12 was dropped.
I re-ran the stamp and it is green.
One new finding, which does not block: the new wording calls `48f52e2` the last commit before the reset, and it is not (f3).
Stamp: I ran `loopctl gate stamp` in the worktree.
It printed `stamp green: f0b89f97b30326f7e85c1b2f5e9fc369c61242195419301dda9dde60d5734577`.
Gates pre_commit and cli_tests passed, and so did rows r1 to r5 and r7 to r10.
The fingerprint matches the round's binds.
f1: `grep -rn loop/archive .okf docs README.md` finds two lines.
One is the new log line.
The other is `practices/plan-premise-sweep.md:498`, which says closed tickets sit under `.loop/archive/<slug>/` at `48f52e2`.
That is true.
I pulled every ticket slug from the 30 rewritten Evidence lines (49 unique) and checked each against `git ls-tree -r 48f52e2 .loop`.
None is missing.

The one remaining older wording, `acme-certificate-job.md:144` ("its plan is `.loop/plans/` in git history before `5b2ed1b`"), is true: `.loop/plans/T5-tls-certificate-expiry-alert.md` exists at `48f52e2`.
f2: I read the minio.md diff.
Lines 103 to 108 say R12 was dropped in `a7aa595`, and that R10 and R11 were still stubs at the reset.
This agrees with the round 1 check against `git show a7aa595`.
Log: `.okf/log.md` gets one new line, appended, and r7 still passes (no removed log lines, every touched concept named).
r8 still passes, so no decision body changed in this round.
f1: resolved.
The Evidence lines now point at `.loop/` at `48f52e2`, which holds every ticket they name.
f2: resolved at `.okf/components/minio.md:106-108`.
f3: open, docs, non-blocking.
`git log --format=%h -1 5b2ed1b^` gives `2259e07`.
Between `48f52e2` and the reset come `1a4ba61`, `992fb87` and `2259e07`, all `loop: stamp`.
`git diff --name-only 48f52e2 2259e07` lists only stamp, gate-output and gates.jsonl files, so the plans and verdicts are the same and the pointer still works.
Only the clause "the last commit before the `5b2ed1b` loop reset" is false.
The plain fix is to drop the clause, or to say "the last commit before the reset that changed a plan or verdict", in all 30 files.
